items.body: Review by alainPP — Quivira?the legendary name of a city of gold, forever sought but never found!It is also the concept behind an album by Lisa LaRue, who shines on keyboards and piano.1. (Intro) "The Coming Of The Spaniards" offers a symphonic, solemn, and majestic opening?a melody that stops you in your tracks. The choirs, the piano, the very essence of the music?simply perfect.2. "The Benefits Of Breathing Quietly" follows, featuring Vangelis-esque tones?sublime, with a distant, Native American-inspired breeze. Jake's vocals flirt with the style of Big Big Train; in short, top-tier stuff. The synth kicks in, riding over violin-like tones; it's simple yet beautiful, with hints of Alan Parsons?nothing but quality here.3. "The Plains? Truth" features a slow, drifting violin in "space-folk" mode?an airy instrumental interlude?concluding with an Andalusian acoustic touch that remains captivating throughout.4. "Quivira Bound" places the keyboard center stage; Jake casts a spell with his distinctive voice?not the late John, certainly, but his vocals are pure prog. It's an 80s-style ballad with a cheerful air; Lisa brings out a smaller synth before a Southern-rock/Cherokee guitar spirit floods the room with bewitching notes, with John embracing his role as an ex-Korgis member. A stereo finale blends the organ with the crystalline piano.5. "Moving Forward" reminds me of Solstice, featuring a jazzy-folk sound where Joe's violin engages in a musical duel. KANSAS is definitely present here after all, and the keyboards blend perfectly for one of the album's surprising detours.6. "The Turk/Follow The Wind" follows with organ, piano, and violin?sampled or not? That is the question. The drums aren't credited, implying they are programmed, which takes a bit of the shine off the album. Otherwise, it's a fine, energetic track that would have been a hit in the 70s! The cinematic ending puts my mind at ease.7. "Nothing Is Everything" marks the second half of the album?Side B. It has that KANSAS vibe again, with plenty of piano; softer yet dynamic, it feels like an 80s tune?over 40 years old; is it impossible to invent something new these days? Anyway, at times I hear ALAN PARSONS in "Andalusian mode"?it's a strange sensation.8. "Carved From The Sun," with its warm organ, reminds me of SHADOW GALLERY?that's just how it is. The velvety keyboard work lets the track drift along a smooth, seamless melodic path?paradoxically so.9. "Kicking Rocks" arrives, driven by a catchy guitar and a heavy riff; then it settles back down for a repeat performance.10. "Prelude To Anywhere/Weekend Conquistadors"... is it the spellbinding piano, the violin, or the synth? A beautiful ballad assaulted by John's hard-rocking riff, with the piano returning to sweep away any lingering heaviness. A masterful battle between the two instruments?top-tier stuff?with Jake setting things on fire, as does the PROTO-KAW-style vocal.11. "Still Breathing," with notes that recall TEARS FOR FEARS?that's just how it is. The final track; instead of leaving me breathless, it fills me up. A ballad?a lament balancing tenderness and emotion?featuring a violin? a keyboard? building to a dreamlike crescendo that drifts away on the musical breeze. A touch of Alan Parsons once again highlights the profound musicality of this final, spellbinding track. Off you go, steed?scram!QUIVIRA: symphonic progressive rock; a modern myth and vision of our troubled society set to music; melodic instrumental prog with occasional vocals?very good, yet it also tends to go in circles. Mr. Cadbury really shouldn't have wandered in.(3.75)
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑以传说中的黄金之城Quivira为概念核心，由键盘手Lisa LaRue领衔，融合交响前摇的庄严与北美原住民文化意象。编曲以钢琴、合成器与管风琴为骨架，辅以南方摇滚质感的吉他段落和小提琴对位，整体呈现出向KANSAS、Alan Parsons、Shadow Gallery等70至80年代老牌前摇乐队致敬的姿态。十一首曲目按概念专辑结构铺陈，从西班牙人到来开篇，经平原探索到征服者主题层层推进，器乐段落考究但旋律走向偏保守。制作层面有数字鼓的痕迹，部分段落被乐评指出缺乏新意。人声风格参照Big Big Train与Proto-Kaw，属于工整的类型内作品，与用户偏好的实验、爵士、电子及暗潮方向距离较远，但在传统交响前摇范畴内展现出扎实的器乐编排与概念完整性。

items.body: Harry Birch wrote “Don’t Give Up” while he was drinking himself under and his mother was dying of bone cancer. “This song saved me,” he says. He wrote it for her. The music pulls against all that: warm bass, guitar ringing bright over it, the tempo unhurried. Only the first line gives it away, Birch calling himself “a whiskey walking junkie”. Halfway through the song, he hands a verse to Lunda, a French-Congolese singer working in soul and indie rock. The chorus asks for time to put a broken life back together: “Please don’t give up on me / ‘Cause oh on our love we can revive / the pieces of our life…” Birch is Kaya Street, the Bristol project he writes, sings and produces. He formed it in 2014 as a ten-piece soul band, broke it up in early 2024 to get into the studio properly, then rebuilt it at the end of that year around live horns, drums and electronics. Juno-winning Toronto producer Dubmatix is producing the next Kaya Street album. “Don’t Give Up” stands apart from the afrobeat he usually works in, and from the political songs that come with it. items._cn_summary: Kaya Street是Harry Birch在布里斯托创建的音乐项目，最初以十人灵魂乐队形式存在，2024年初解散后重组为以现场铜管、鼓机和电子设备为核心的编制。多伦多制作人Dubmatix将操刀其下一张专辑。这首《Don't Give Up》创作于Birch酗酒且母亲因骨癌即将离世的时期，他称这首歌'拯救了自己'。音乐层面以温暖的低音线和明亮的吉他为主，节奏从容不迫，与歌词的沉重形成对照。歌曲中段邀请法国-刚果歌手Lunda演唱一段，合唱部分表达请求时间修复破碎生活的愿望。该作品偏离了Birch惯常的非洲节拍路线，转向灵魂与独立摇滚的抒情表达，注重情感叙事而非声音实验或结构创新。

items.body: Novena Senda releases the single and music video “A la deriva”, the first preview of the Barcelona band’s second album. The song moves between darkwave and the Spanish-language rock of Héroes del Silencio, wrapped in an atmosphere the band ties to the 1980s and 1990s. “A la deriva” deals with exhaustion and the feeling of being lost. It follows Novena Senda’s 2022 debut album “Laberinto de Voces”, the record that established the band’s sound between darkwave and Spanish-language rock, with echoes of Depeche Mode and Héroes del Silencio. About Novena Senda The band formed in Barcelona in 2017, with Lorenzo Ferrer, Edu Migueles and David Arroyo making up the band. Their 2022 debut album “Laberinto de Voces” set out the sound they have built on since: darkwave merged with Spanish-language rock, carrying an atmosphere that nods to Depeche Mode and Héroes del Silencio. “A la deriva”, released in 2026, is the first single from the follow-up to that debut, with the rest of the album still to come.

items.body: Vampire Valentine release “Scarred & Sacred” on October 25, 2026 via Morella Records. The six-track EP is the UK darkwave and post-punk trio’s fourth release since signing to the label on January 15, 2026, following a run of singles, the “Pale Dawn” EP and their self-titled debut album this past August. Where the self-titled album was a complete statement of the band’s sound, “Scarred & Sacred” follows a single arc across its six tracks: sin, repentance and the reckoning that waits at the gate. “Scarred & Sacred is our sins repenting and facing your fate in the afterlife at the gate,” the band says. “We wanted six tracks that felt like one story, not six songs that happened to ship together. It starts calm and it does not stay that way.” Scarred & Sacred tracklist Scarred (instrumental) – an atmospheric, melodic intro that turns unsettling, setting up the EP. Broken Sins – a full-length track pairing darkwave production with post-punk revival. Talisman – the story of a lover placing a talisman with a dying partner to guide them to the other side. Lover Not A Biter (instrumental) – a hard-driven darksynth track. GORE! (instrumental) – a darksynth cut the band describes as built on 1980s horror soundtracks and visuals. Sacred – the title track and closer, a post-punk song ending on vocals from frontman Michael Longstaff. Credits Michael Longstaff handles lyrics and vocals, Kieron Wright plays bass and Tobias Cowen Pickard plays drums. Tony Gunk produced, composed, mixed and mastered all six tracks. Ricky Conover, who records as Forerunnerx, co-produced and co-composed “Scarred”, “Lover Not A Biter” and “GORE!”. Blake Carpenter plays guitar on “Broken Sins”, “Talisman”, “Lover Not A Biter” and “GORE!”. About Vampire Valentine Vampire Valentine is a darkwave and post-punk band from Newcastle upon Tyne, formed in October 2025 by producer Michael Longstaff and bassist/guitarist Kieron Wright, who connected through a mutual acquaintance, along with drummer Tobias Cowen Pickard. US producers Ricky Conover (Forerunnerx) and Tony Gunk handle production. The band draws on The Sisters of Mercy, Twin Tribes, She Past Away and Lebanon Hanover. They debuted on November 14, 2025 with the single “Porcelain”, backed with “Olivia”, which goth journalist Mick Mercer called an “Excellent Debut”. A second single, “Thorns”, followed on December 1, 2025. Vampire Valentine signed to Morella Records on January 15, 2026 and released their debut full-length album that August, having already shared the singles “In The Dark” and “Cutting Ties” from it. “Scarred & Sacred”, out October 25, follows as the band’s fourth Morella release in under a year.

items.body: Assemblage 23 releases “Believe (INHALT Remix)” on 2 October 2026 via Metropolis Records. The single reworks “Believe”, the opening track from Tom Shear’s tenth Assemblage 23 album “Null”, released in November 2025. The remix comes from US producer Matia Simovich, who records as INHALT. “In INHALT’s expert hands, this song has been transformed. It has one foot on the mid-’80s dancefloor and the other planted firmly in the future,” Shear says of the rework. Believe (INHALT Remix) by Assemblage 23 “Believe” first appeared on “Null”, which Shear promoted with a UK tour ahead of its release and a run of sold-out shows in Germany. He returns to Europe this October for further dates in Germany and Sweden, several of which are already sold out. “‘Believe’ is about a hope for better things, even with the state of the world as it is today,” Shear said when the song first came out. “We are responsible for making the kind of world we live in. In the face of bad times, sometimes the most subversive thing you can do is to have hope.” Assemblage 23 live dates, October 2026 20 October – Karlsruhe, Die Stadtmitte (Germany) 21 October – Oberhausen, Kulttempel (Germany) 22 October – Hamburg, Indra Musikclub (Germany) 23 October – Jönköping, SekktorF (Sweden) – sold out 24 October – Hannover, Subkultur (Germany) – sold out Remaining tickets are available through the Assemblage 23 website. About Assemblage 23 Assemblage 23 is the recording name of US producer and songwriter Tom Shear, active since the late 1990s. His debut album “Contempt” placed him at the front of the electro-industrial and Future Pop scene that took hold on underground dancefloors at the turn of the millennium. Side-Line interviewed Shear about his long career and songwriting process. “Null”, Shear’s tenth album as Assemblage 23, was announced for Metropolis Records and released on 7 November 2025, led by the single “Tolerate”. Shear’s lyrics have long dealt directly with difficult personal subjects, including suicide and depression, a directness that has built him a following that keeps him touring regularly. “Believe (INHALT Remix)”, out 2 October 2026, pairs the “Null” opener with a rework by Matia Simovich (INHALT) ahead of Assemblage 23’s latest run of European dates.
items._cn_summary: 本文为Assemblage 23发布INHALT混音版单曲Believe的新闻稿。Tom Shear的第十张专辑Null中的开场曲Believe由美国制作人Matia Simovich（INHALT）重新混音，将原作推向了80年代中期舞曲与未来感兼具的方向。歌曲主题围绕对更美好事物的希望，强调即使世界处境艰难，个人仍应对未来怀抱希望。文章同时介绍了Shear的欧洲巡演日期及厂牌背景。作为electro-industrial与Future Pop领域的资深制作人，Shear长期以直白的方式处理抑郁、自杀等个人议题。该文本质上属于唱片发行公告，缺乏对声音设计、混音技法或音乐结构的实质性乐评分析。

items.body: Miss Construction returns with “This Is Crap”, a new EBM and industrial-electro album that pairs eleven new tracks with a reissue of the project’s 2008 debut. Out 27 November 2026 on Out Of Line as a 2CD digipak, it follows “Boys & Ladies”, the sixth single, released 30 September. Disc one holds the eleven new tracks: This Is Crap (Intro) 6666 Heiß Hate Spiel Mit Mir Back Again F.M.P. Boys & Ladies This Is War Bully Du This Is Crap by Miss Construction Disc two reissues “Kunstprodukt,” Miss Construction’s debut album, originally released 28 April 2008 on Fear Section. It adds two archival remixes to the original sixteen tracks: the title track remixed by Gintronic, and “Electro Beast” remixed by Dolls Of Pain. “Boys & Ladies” arrived as an official video through Out Of Line Music’s YouTube channel on 30 September, embedded below. Miss Construction’s road back to ‘This Is Crap’ “Boys & Ladies” caps a run of five singles that marked Miss Construction’s return: “Spiel Mit Mir” in October 2025, “Back Again” in December 2025, then “Heiß,” “Hate” and “F.M.P.” through 2026. “This Is Crap” is available to pre-order now through the Out Of Line shop and on Bandcamp. About Miss Construction Miss Construction began in 2008 as a side project of Chris Pohl, who had fronted Blutengel since 1996. Pohl brought in Gordon Mocznay as co-vocalist, and the pair debuted the project at Wave-Gotik-Treffen in Leipzig that year. Its opening statement was a cover of Terminal Choice’s “Totes Fleisch,” placed on the debut album “Kunstprodukt,” released 28 April 2008 on Fear Section, an Out Of Line sublabel. Pohl and Mocznay followed it with “United Trash – The Z Files” in November 2013. Between full-lengths, Miss Construction contributed remixes to Blutengel and Dance Or Die compilations between 2009 and 2011, including the “Awake The Machines” and “Industrial For The Masses” series, before the project went quiet for twelve years. Pohl revived Miss Construction in 2025. “Spiel Mit Mir” opened the comeback that October, “Back Again” followed in December, and “Heiß,” “Hate,” “F.M.P.” and “Boys & Ladies” continued it through 2026. “This Is Crap” closes that run of singles and gives “Kunstprodukt” its first reissue.

items.body: Corlyx released “The Holy Vampire” on 1 October 2026, the fourth single from “The Crimson Tapes,” the darkwave trio’s next album due in early 2027 on Out Of Line Music. Guitarist and producer Brandon Ashley made the track with singer Caitlin Stokes, who also directed and edited its companion video alongside Sereina Winters. Ashley called the track’s tone deliberate: “It’s also quite camp, which Corlyx is a huge fan of.” He placed it close to 2025’s “Purple Pain,” pairing dancefloor elements with a harder deathrock edge than that album. Corlyx’s ‘The Holy Vampire’ leads to ‘The Crimson Tapes’ “The Holy Vampire” is streaming now and available on Bandcamp. About Corlyx Corlyx call their sound “Death Pop,” a label singer Caitlin Stokes coined for a mix of 1980s post-punk and goth rock. The band started in Los Angeles, releasing its first single, “Starlet,” in February 2016, and now splits its time between the UK and Italy, where Stokes works with guitarist and producer Brandon Ashley and bassist Davide Rocco. Corlyx’s video for “Twist Like An Animal” arrived in 2019. The band announced the album “Blood In The Disco” in 2021 behind the single “Take Off Everything,” then returned in 2024 with “Zombie Kid” ahead of the double album “Purple Pain” the following year. Corlyx has toured Europe, the UK and the US with Lord Of The Lost, Massive Ego, Ashbury Heights, Blutengel and Twin Tribes. “Sweeter Than Blood,” “More Anarchy” and “Your Heart In The Serpent’s Mouth” preceded “The Holy Vampire” as the first three singles from “The Crimson Tapes.”

items.body: Danish/UK electronic duo Oui Plastique release the single “For The Cry Of Anguish” on October 16, 2026 through Town and Towers Records. It is the fourth and final single from the project’s second album, “Forever Will Be Over Before You Know It”, due November 27, 2026 on the same Danish label. A Bandcamp page for the single had not gone live at the time of writing. Oui Plastique close the singles campaign for ‘Forever Will Be Over Before You Know It’ “For The Cry Of Anguish” follows three earlier singles from the same album: “Revival” in April 2026, “Linger” on June 12, 2026, and “Spirit” on September 4, 2026. “Forever Will Be Over Before You Know It” is Oui Plastique’s second album, following the 2022 debut “Fraternity of Strangers”. It runs 14 tracks and releases digitally, on CD and on vinyl through Town and Towers Records on November 27, 2026. Oui Plastique set up the song’s premise directly: “For The Cry Of Anguish is a song about seeing something you were never meant to see – and discovering that some things, once witnessed, can never be unseen.“ Oui Plastique previously posted a teaser video for “Forever Will Be Over Before You Know It” to the duo’s YouTube channel, titled “Oui Plastique – ‘Forever Will Be Over Before You Know It’ – Album Teaser”. About Oui Plastique Oui Plastique is the duo of Martin Nyrup (Denmark) and James Thomas (UK). The project grew out of a 2017 collaboration between Nyrup, also one half of the dark wave duo Perpacity, and Thomas, of the band DVL, who together recorded the album “Convergence” that year. In 2018 the pair recorded a three-track covers EP for the UnMute project, a tribute to Mute Records, released on Bandcamp as “UM EP 04” on February 1, 2019. Before the debut album, four of its eventual tracks appeared as standalone digital singles: “Failure” on March 8, 2021, “The Fear” on May 28, 2021, “Crossing Over” on September 24, 2021, and “Wish Yourself Away” on November 26, 2021. The 11-track debut album “Fraternity of Strangers” followed on January 28, 2022, on CD through ScentAir Records. A remastered edition of “Convergence” followed in 2022. In August 2025, the UnMute covers were remastered and reissued across platforms as the EP “UnMute”, featuring the Martin Gore-associated tracks “Compulsion”, “The Bottom Line” and “It Doesn’t Matter Two”, through Town and Towers Records. Nyrup’s other project, Perpacity, released the album “Discordia” in 2023 and the Danish-language single “Lille Flamme” in May 2025. “Forever Will Be Over Before You Know It” arrives on November 27, 2026. It is Oui Plastique’s first full-length through Town and Towers Records, following the 2022 debut on ScentAir Records.

items.album: My Life with the Thrill Kill Kult’s ‘The Reincarnation of Luna’ turns 25 on 2 October
items.excerpt: Chicago industrial dance band My Life with the Thrill Kill Kult released “The Reincarnation of Luna” on 2 October 2001 through SleazeBox Records, the band’s own label, distributed by Invisible Records. The album turns 25 this year. My Life with the Thrill Kill Kult recorded and mixed the album at Starlust Studios in Los Angeles, with Buzz McCoy producing. Groovie Mann and Buzz McCoy wrote all twelve tracks, performed with the Bomb Gang Girlz, and Chris Greene handled mastering.
items.body: Chicago industrial dance band My Life with the Thrill Kill Kult released “The Reincarnation of Luna” on 2 October 2001 through SleazeBox Records, the band’s own label, distributed by Invisible Records. The album turns 25 this year. My Life with the Thrill Kill Kult recorded and mixed the album at Starlust Studios in Los Angeles, with Buzz McCoy producing. Groovie Mann and Buzz McCoy wrote all twelve tracks, performed with the Bomb Gang Girlz, and Chris Greene handled mastering. The tracklist runs: “Radio Silicon” “The Untouchable Class” “Hour of Zero” “The Kult Konnection” “Girl Without a Planet” “Temptation Serenade” “Bettie” “Flesh Playhouse” “Heelz Afire” “Jungle of Love” “Asylum Disciple” “Theme De Luna” “The Reincarnation of Luna” was My Life with the Thrill Kill Kult’s first release on their own SleazeBox Records imprint, following “A Crime for All Seasons” (1997) on Red Ant Records. The band released a companion remix set, “Golden Pillz: The Luna Remixes,” and a live album, “Elektrik Inferno,” in the same period. In 2007, the band re-recorded and remixed the album for Rykodisc under the title “The Resurrection of Luna,” adding “Ocean of Hate,” “Hallowed Be My Name” and a remix of “Temptation Serenade.” The original 2001 version remains available through the band’s own site. About My Life with the Thrill Kill Kult My Life with the Thrill Kill Kult, often shortened to Thrill Kill Kult or TKK, formed in Chicago in 1987. Groovie Mann (born Frankie Nardiello) and Buzz McCoy (born Marston Daley) met that year while touring with Ministry and began recording music for an unfinished art film of the same name. Wax Trax! Records released the completed songs as a three-track EP, and when it sold well, the full-length “I See Good Spirits and I See Bad Spirits” followed in 1988. “Confessions of a Knife…” (1990) became one of Wax Trax!’s best-selling releases, and “Sexplosion!” (1991) pushed the band toward a more psychedelic house and disco sound while drawing attention from Interscope Records, which signed the band and released the alternative-radio single “Sex on Wheelz.” “13 Above the Night” (1993) and “Hit & Run Holiday” (1995) followed on Interscope before the band parted ways with the label in 1996. “A Crime for All Seasons” (1997) came out on Red Ant Records, and “The Reincarnation of Luna” (2001) marked the start of the band’s own SleazeBox Records imprint, distributed by Invisible Records. Rykodisc later became the band’s home, reissuing its back catalog alongside the rarities set “Dirty Little Secrets,” the mash-up album “Diamonds & Daggerz” (2004) and the long-shelved “Gay, Black and Married” (2005). SleazeBox partnered with Italy’s Rustblade label in 2009, issuing “Blood + Dope + Sin + Gold” (2008), “Death Threat” (2009) and “Sinister Whisperz” (2011), and Side-Line covered the band’s 2020 “Sinister Whisperz” retrospective installment, “The Rykodisc Years.” Buzz McCoy has also remixed tracks for KMFDM, Pigface and other acts, and recorded as Excessive Force with KMFDM’s Sascha Konietzko. The band has contributed songs to film soundtracks including “Cool World” (1992), “The Crow” (1994), in which members also appeared performing in a nightclub scene, “The Flintstones” (1994), “Showgirls” (1995) and “Baseketball” (1998). My Life with the Thrill Kill Kult toured the US in spring 2026 with support from Heavy Halo, as Side-Line reported at the time, continuing to perform a catalog that this October marks the 25th anniversary of “The Reincarnation of Luna.”
items._cn_summary: 本文为Side-Line杂志发布的纪念性新闻稿，介绍芝加哥工业舞曲乐队My Life with the Thrill Kill Kult 2001年专辑《The Reincarnation of Luna》发行25周年。文章主要罗列了专辑的录制信息、制作人员、曲目列表以及乐队的厂牌变迁史，附带简要的乐队背景介绍。内容以事实陈述为主，缺乏对音乐本身的声音设计、创作理念或艺术价值的深入评论。从风格来看，该乐队属于工业/暗潮/电子舞曲领域，与用户口味的暗潮分类有一定关联，但整体偏向舞曲化商业工业路线，实验性有限。文章性质为纪念性转载新闻而非原创乐评，信息密度较低，分析深度不足。

items.body: Swedish synthpop act Split Vision release the single “Cold War” on 2 October 2026 through the Danish label Town And Towers Records. The track is the second single from the band’s upcoming album “BetaCity”, due on 6 November 2026 on streaming, CD and vinyl. “Cold War” follows “Out of Nowhere”, released on 10 September 2026 as the first single from “BetaCity.” The new track moves into darker territory than its predecessor. Sequenced synthesizers underpin lyrics that revisit Cold War-era paranoia, isolation and secrecy as a metaphor for conflict and uncertainty. The lyrics were written by the band’s label manager, Stig Wintendorff, in the 1980s. The chorus repeats the song’s central image: “Dancing in the shadows of the Cold War night.” The single’s cover artwork draws on Cold War-era imagery: masks, military hardware and Soviet-style visual motifs. Split Vision’s ‘BetaCity’ album Split Vision’s previous album, “Echoes of a New Spell” (2025, Town And Towers Records), drew on the synthesizers and recording approach associated with early Depeche Mode. “BetaCity” turns instead toward the early sound of Alphaville. Town And Towers Records describes the album’s sound as combining “warm analogue synthesizers with colder digital textures, wavetable sounds, sequenced bass lines and atmospheric pads.” Recommended for fans of Alphaville, Depeche Mode and Erasure. About Split Vision Split Vision formed in Sweden in 1985, when two teenage friends started writing synthpop with influences from Depeche Mode, Yazoo, Erasure and Pet Shop Boys. Two more members joined, and the four-piece played discotheques in North Eastern Skåne and appeared on regional radio and talent shows through the late 1980s. Platinum Records released the single “How Will I Ever” in 1988, and “So Many Times” became a minor hit in Sweden before the group disbanded. Dan Hansson and Henric Palmqvist, two of the original members, restarted Split Vision in the spring of 2019 to write new material rooted in the band’s 1980s sound. “We wanted to take the audience on a journey back to carefully carved arpeggios, that smell of Moog and Yamaha DX-7,” the band said of that return, describing music with “strong melodies performed by a distinct lead and backed by a contemporary vocoder.” The result, “Among the Stars,” arrived on 1 October 2020, with lyrics and soundscapes that reference the cosmos. Split Vision signed to the Scandinavian label Town And Towers Records in 2022 and has released several singles and EPs since. A music video for “Lust,” directed by Norwegian filmmaker Öystein Thorsen, followed in August 2024 and won awards at the New York Tri-State International Film Festival and the KHIFF Krimson Horyzon International Film Festival in India. The band has also toured as a support act for the British group China Crisis. “Echoes of a New Spell” followed in 2025, and “Out of Nowhere” opened the “BetaCity” campaign on 10 September 2026. “Cold War,” released 2 October 2026, is the second single from that album, due on 6 November 2026 through Town And Towers Records.
items._cn_summary: 瑞典合成器流行乐队Split Vision发布单曲《Cold War》，为其2026年11月专辑《BetaCity》的第二首先行曲。歌曲以冷战时期的偏执、孤立与隐秘为隐喻主题，序列合成器构成编曲骨架，歌词由厂牌经理Stig Wintendorff于1980年代创作。专辑整体方向从此前Depeche Mode式合成器风格转向Alphaville早期音色，融合模拟合成器温暖质感与数字纹理、波形表音色、序列贝斯线及氛围铺垫。乐队1985年成立于瑞典，2019年由两位原始成员重组，2022年签约丹麦独立厂牌Town And Towers Records。该作品属于复古导向的合成器流行范畴，与暗潮氛围有所关联但创新空间有限，信息呈现偏新闻稿性质。

items.body: Review by Warthur — Before Le Orme retooled themselves as a prog act, they were putting out British Invasion-inspiredpsychedelia, a sound captured on this brief debut album. It's decent enough fare, and the groundingin psychedelic rock probably put the band in a good position to shift gear to prog in the early1970s, essentially engaging in parallel evolution alongside Genesis, whose debut is similarlyuncharacteristic of their later sound and similarly steeped in psychedelic trends of the era.Appreciated in its own right, this is decent enough if you're a big psychedelia fan, but it won'tscratch the itch if you're in the mood for anything that sounds like anything the band recordedafter this.

items._cn_summary: 这是意大利乐队Le Orme在1969年发行的首张专辑，彼时他们尚未转型为前卫摇滚乐手，仍在创作受英国入侵浪潮影响的迷幻摇滚作品。乐评将其与Genesis的首张专辑相类比——同样深受当时迷幻潮流浸染，也同样不能代表乐队此后的成熟风格。整张专辑时长不长，呈现出六十年代末迷幻摇滚的典型面貌：吉他音色湿润、编曲结构相对传统。乐评认为，若作为独立作品来欣赏，对迷幻摇滚爱好者而言尚可一听；但若期待听到乐队后来在前卫摇滚领域展现的成熟与深度，则这张早期作品难以满足。整体而言，这是一张具有时代过渡意义的早期录音，记录了乐队风格形成前的探索阶段。

items.body: Review by brainsuccasurgery — Still Thick As A Brick? Of course, this title evokes that of Jethro Tull's masterpiece, *Thick As A Brick* (TAAB for those in the know or the lazy), to which Ian Anderson himself gave a sequel 40 years later: *Thick As A Brick 2* (2012). *Still Thick As A Brick* isn't Tull's *TAAB* Episode 3, but rather the album by a new band led by Berlin-based Lutz Meinert?who also fronts the psychedelic rock band Margin?supported on acoustic guitar and vocals by Englishman Paul Forrest, a member of the Jethro Tull Experience, Crystal Palace guitarist Nils Conrad, and American flutist Ulla Hartmuth, whose virtuosity on the instrument rivals that of Ian Anderson. Despite nearly identical track titles (of course, it's a joke?), *Still Thick As A Brick* is neither a sequel to *TAAB* nor a simple cover of that legendary album. Just as TAAB told the story of Gerald Bostock, Still Thick As A Brick aims to tell the story of an inspiring figure: the famous financial magnate Georges Boston. Personally, I'd never heard of him, but as Reflection Club points out, to learn more about him, all we have to do is read what Rellington Stone magazine has to say?an entire issue of which is included in the CD booklet. Ha! Ha!Musically, there are plenty of similarities to TAAB, the most striking being Paul Forrest's singing style, with a slightly nasal voice very similar to that of Ian Anderson from the '70s. On *Still Thick As A Brick*, we also find that same playful flute that pops up at any moment, that same sense of rhythmic disruption, that recurring acoustic guitar developing highly catchy folk-rock themes, that anachronistic yet electrifying harpsichord, that delightful Hammond organ?worthy of John Evan's?an instrument particularly showcased on the exhilarating "The Foray of the Sharks " (5:37) or the very Tull-esque rock track "The Great Dance Around the Golden Calf" (3:35).Reflection Club intentionally set out to make an album "in the style of" and has succeeded in creating a thrilling work, close in spirit to TAAB (not to mention the very obvious nods) but one that manages to stand on its own, with some tracks less tied to Jethro Tull's '70s style. For example, the jazzy tones of "Nervesoothers" (3:10) place it more firmly between Camel and The Tangent. Furthermore, the contributions of guest musicians on sitar and violin, as well as a few brass notes (likely played on a synthesizer), judiciously enrich the atmosphere. And Reflection Club doesn't hesitate to vary the moods, stepping away from the bouncy symphonic folk-prog typical of Tull to embrace a tender pop-rock sound on the aptly named "Sentimental Depreciation" (5:19). Thus, after a few listens?from the magnificently symphonic "Prelude" (2:00) to the closing "Look Across The Sea" (4:24), a sort of sea shanty dominated by bagpipes?STAAB manages to make us forget TAAB for 48 minutes.So I have to admit that Reflection Club skillfully showcases more personality and originality than its album title would suggest. While it doesn't quite reach the creative heights of its brilliant and unsurpassed?more or less acknowledged?role model, Still Thick As A Brick captures all of its timeless charm, making for an undeniably enjoyable listen that should appeal to a wide audience, not just longtime Jethro Tull fans. And if Ian Anderson's TAAB 2 didn't quite win them over, they can safely give this Still TAAB a listen to make up for it.
items._cn_summary: Reflection Club的《Still Thick as a Brick》是一张以Jethro Tull经典专辑《Thick as a Brick》为蓝本的致敬之作，由柏林音乐人Lutz Meinert领衔，集合了长笛、键盘、吉他等乐手阵容。专辑沿用了原作的曲名框架，但叙事对象被替换为虚构金融人物Georges Boston，CD内页附有虚构杂志《Rellington Stone》的整期内容作为概念包装。音乐上以原声吉他、民谣摇滚主题为主，辅以长笛、哈普西科德、哈蒙德管风琴等七十年代前卫摇滚元素，部分曲目融入爵士调式和锡塔琴、小提琴等点缀。整体制作以模仿和致敬为核心，虽有部分原创性尝试，但主要风格仍处于传统前卫民谣摇滚范畴内，与用户偏好的实验、avant-garde、电子、世界音乐等方向距离较远。

items.body: Review by KansasForEver4 — Five years have passed since CASTANARC's rather mediocre *The Sea of ​​Broken Vows*, which featured eleven tracks ranging from three to five minutes in length?none of them particularly progressive in ambition. This time around, the approach is worlds apart from its predecessor: the album consists of just three tracks, with even the shortest one exceeding the length of the longest song on the 2021 release. One might well call this a "palace revolution"?a genuine surprise, as you can imagine.To appreciate CASTANARC, you first need to like Mark Holiday's somewhat distinctive voice?especially since the album is heavily vocal-driven, though the singing is superb. Yet CASTANARC is also defined by Mark Powell's multifaceted keyboards, which appear all over the album; there is plenty of piano, very little organ, and likely many sounds run through a Mellotron-style filter, with the smooth, fluid synthesizer work serving as the Doncaster band's trademark.We must also mention?lest anyone be overlooked?Neil Duty's excellent guitar work on the second track, "Ceasefire for the Innocent" (Duty previously appeared on the band's 1984 debut, *Journey to the East*, alongside Holiday and Powell); guest musician Dave Holley's contribution is equally impressive on the short "Cue Rain" (though at six minutes, "short" is relative); and the rhythm section?Peter Robinson on bass and Charlie Morgan on drums?delivers a solid, highly competent performance.While it doesn't break the mold with radical originality (remaining firmly within a very conventional neo-progressive vein), it is a fantastic surprise given the band's previous output.
items._cn_summary: CASTANARC在2026年发行了专辑《Forged by the Sun》，相比前作碎片化的短曲结构，本作大幅转向长篇形式，仅收录三首作品，每首均超过前作最长曲目长度，形成显著的'宫廷革命'。音乐以人声为主导，键盘演奏者Mark Powell提供了丰富的钢琴、合成器铺底和少量风琴音色，辅以Mellotron式的弦乐质感，构成了这支Doncaster乐队标志性的流畅电子键盘音色。第二首《Ceasefire for the Innocent》中吉他手Neil Duty表现出色，Duty曾在乐队1984年首张专辑《Journey to the East》中亮相；客座乐手Dave Holley在《Cue Rain》中亦有精彩发挥。贝斯与鼓构成的节奏组表现稳健。整体而言，作品仍深植于传统新前卫摇滚的语法之内，并未突破类型常规，但相较乐队此前的产出是一次令人瞩目的进化。

items.body: Review by DimitrisTheHead — Another really strong Procol Harum album, after their debut. Procol Harum is a great example of a less-is-more band, delivering strong music without being to complex or trying to be sophisticated. The music is piano/organ/vocal driven, the trademark Procol Harum sound, led by Gary Brooker and his warm, emotional voice. Matthew Fisher on the organ is again fantastic. The album is not loaded with guitar, but when Robin Trower comes in, he delivers some really tasty and artful sounds.I like all the songs here, and the highlight is the heavy psychedelic/progressive suite "In Held 'Twas In I" with classical and Eastern music influences.
items._genre: progressive rock / psychedelic rock / chamber pop
items._cn_summary: Procol Harum 1968年的第二张专辑延续了首作的简约路线，以钢琴、风琴和人声为核心架构。Gary Brooker温暖而富有情感的歌喉与Matthew Fisher的风琴演奏构成主要音色基底，Robin Trower的吉他仅在需要时点缀出现，带来精致而富有艺术感的音色。整张专辑最具分量的作品是长达十七分钟的组曲'In Held 'Twas In I'，融合了古典音乐结构与东方音乐元素，在迷幻与进步摇滚之间开辟出独特的叙事空间。乐队秉持少即是多的创作理念，不过度追求复杂性，以克制的手法营造出层次丰富的聆听体验。整体而言，这是一张旋律优雅、制作考究的前卫摇滚专辑，但对追求实验性、即兴性或电子化的听众来说，其表达手法相对传统内敛。

items.body: Collage artist Amanda Lee Stilwell of LastCraft Designs and Rosebud Tarot has been reading tarot for over two decades, which is probably long enough to start wondering why the major arcana should have all the fun when an entire generation of musicians spent the 80s dressing as though they had wandered out of an occult manuscript with a synthesizer under one arm. A few years ago, Stilwell began assembling her own artisan deck, filling it with elaborate digital collages drawn from the faces, fashions, poses, and peculiar glamour of New Wave, while borrowing some of the symbolic machinery associated with Pamela Colman Smith’s Rider-Waite illustrations and the Thoth deck. Now, it is currently on display at the Morgan Library’s tarot exhibit in New York City. The resulting New Wave Tarot works because Stilwell clearly knows both sides of the joke. She has done her tarot homework, but she has also paid attention to the people whose records, photographs, haircuts, eyeliner, and stage personas made them such natural candidates for divination in the first place. The suit of Pentacles, or Disks, becomes gold LP records; Swords become microphones; Cups turn into teacups, an affectionate nod to the considerable British presence in the deck; and Wands are represented by eyeliner, which may be one of the few substitutions in tarot history that feels immediately self-explanatory. Then come the casting choices, where the project begins behaving like the record collection of an especially stylish fortune teller. Siouxsie Sioux takes her rightful place as the High Priestess, while Kate Bush presides over the Moon. Fad Gadget, with almost suspicious perfection, appears as the Fool. Robert Smith assumes the King of Cups and returns alongside Mary Poole as the Lovers, a pairing that hardly requires an explanatory pamphlet. Klaus Nomi and David Bowie command the Chariot; Gary Numan becomes the Magician; Budgie and Siouxsie share the Two of Cups. Dave Gahan, Depeche Mode’s dark prince, gets the Devil, while perhaps the smartest piece of casting in the entire deck gives Genesis P-Orridge the card associated with transformation, rupture, passage, and renewal: Death. LastCraft began in 2013 as an outlet for Stilwell’s collage work, pop-cultural fixations, and interest in witchcraft. The company first made its name with an assortment of pop-culture candles, then expanded rapidly as enamel pins, patches, and other witchy accessories joined the catalogue. Stilwell has continued developing her tarot work through projects, including the Rosebud Tarot deck with Diana Rose, which uses found and vintage photography within her recognizable collage approach. The backs of the New Wave Tarot cards carry 80s-inspired geometric designs threaded with roses, giving the deck the look of something that might have fallen out of the sleeve of an obscure 12-inch single bought in 1983 and kept ever since for reasons nobody can adequately explain. Each card measures just under 3 by 5 inches, comes with rounded corners, and is printed on premium thick card stock. The complete deck ships in a tuck box with a fold-out guide explaining the cards and offering instructions for readers who would like to consult your higher self with this wonderfully strange congregation. Your order comes shipped in a tuck box that holds the entire deck and a fold-out description of cards and details on how to read the deck. This order is a preorder. They anticipate shipping out decks by the end of October 2026. NOTE: This will be the final printing of the New Wave Tarot, which has been out of print for several years and revived due to high demand. The deck is available for pre-sale ONLY here. They hope to reach 150 orders minimum. Music fans, dabblers in the occult, you know what to do. Let the spirits move you. Major Arcana cards include: Gary Numan Siouxsie Sioux Nina Hagen Peter Murphy Nick Cave Robert Smith/Mary Poole Klaus Nomi/David Bowie Frank Tovey Andrew Eldritch Devo Grace Jones Ian Curtis Gen P-Orridge Morrissey Dave Gahan Kate Bush Marc Almond Pete Burns Photo: Alice Teeple Model: Frankie Starker The post New Wave Tarot Deals a Final Hand with Siouxsie Sioux, Dave Gahan, Robert Smith, and More! appeared first on Post-Punk.com.

items.body: De/Vision, the German synth-pop duo of Steffen Keth and Thomas Adam, released their sixth studio album “Two” on 1 October 2001 through E-Wave Records, a division of Drakkar Entertainment GmbH distributed by BMG. The De/Vision “Two” album turns 25 this year. It was the first De/Vision studio album recorded as a duo, following Markus Ganssert’s departure from the band in 2000. De/Vision ‘Two’ tracklist and credits The ten-track CD runs “All I Ever Do,” “Silent Moan,” “Drowning Soul,” “Heroine,” “Blindness,” “Heart-Shaped Tumor,” “State of Mind,” “Escape the World,” “Uncaring Machine” and “Lonely Day.” Georg Kaleve produced and mixed the album, with Keth handling pre-production; Stefan Ulrich engineered the sessions, recorded across Pizza Hat and Mikrokosmos-Studio in Berlin and Palais Aux Etoiles in Bremen, and Michael Schwabe mastered the record at Skyline Tonfabrik in Düsseldorf. Achim Färber played drums, Josef Bach added piano, and Kaleve, Bach and Lars Baumgardt contributed guitar; vocalist Sandrine appears on “State of Mind” and Clara Hill supplies additional vocals elsewhere on the album. Dirk Rudolph designed the sleeve around cover photography by Christof Schulte and band photography by Harald Hoffmann. “Two” peaked at number 42 on the German album chart. Lead single “Heart-Shaped Tumor” reached number 89 in Germany that September, De/Vision’s first charting single since “We Fly… Tonight” in 1998. A Different Drum issued a separate US edition of the album in 2004, and Popgefahr Records released a 17-track deluxe reissue of “Two” in 2016, adding instrumental and remix material to the original ten songs. About De/Vision De/Vision formed in July 1988 in Bensheim, near Darmstadt, Germany, as a quartet of Steffen Keth, Thomas Adam, Markus Ganssert and Stefan Blender. Blender left in 1991. The band self-released the single “Your Hands on My Skin” in 1990 and issued “Boy on the Street” in 1992 through Synthetic Product Records, before the 1993 maxi single “Try to Forget” brought them to Strange Ways Records. The debut album “World Without End” followed in January 1994, and “Unversed in Love” arrived in January 1995, both on Strange Ways. “Fairyland?” followed in August 1996 and became the band’s first German chart entry, and “Monosex” moved the band to WEA Records in 1998, reaching number 30. Ganssert left the group in 2000, the same year “Void” reached number 34 on WEA. Keth and Adam, now a duo, signed to E-Wave Records for “Two,” released on 1 October 2001 and distributed internationally through BMG. The duo continued on E-Wave through “Devolution” (2003), “6 Feet Underground” (2004), “Subkutan” (2006) and “NOOB” (2007), before founding their own label, Popgefahr Records, in 2009. Later albums “Popgefahr” (2010), “Rockets and Swords” (2012), “13” (2016) and “Citybeats” (2018) all appeared on Popgefahr, alongside the 2016 deluxe reissue of “Two.” Keth also records with Daniel Myer of Haujobb as Devision Redux, and De/Vision themselves toured with Lakeside X and Empathy Test in 2025. Twenty-five years on, “Two” marks the album that opened the Keth/Adam duo era of the band.

items.body: Wumpscut’s eighth studio album, “Wreath of Barbs,” turns 25 this year. The German electro-industrial project released the record on 1 October 2001 through Beton Kopf Media in Germany, with Metropolis Records issuing the US edition on 9 October 2001. Wumpscut is the recording name of Bavarian musician Rudy Ratzinger, who wrote, arranged, performed, mixed and mastered the album himself. “Wreath of Barbs” runs eleven tracks: “Opening the Gates of Hell,” “Deliverance (Album Mix),” “Wreath of Barbs (Album Mix),” “Dr. Thodt,” “Mankind’s Disease,” “Christfuck,” “Troops Under Fire,” “Line of Corpses,” “Hate Is Mine,” “Bleed in Silence” and a remix of Kirlian Camera’s “Eclipse,” titled “Eclipse (Kaelte Container Remix).” Aleta Welling contributes female vocals and wrote the lyrics for “Wreath of Barbs” and “Dr. Thodt.” The album peaked at #13 on the CMJ RPM Chart in the US. Exclaim! described it as “a celebration of darkness and foreboding” and praised “Ratzinger’s talent for writing a catchy song.” Concurrent with the release, Ratzinger ran a remix contest for the title track, providing samples through his website and inviting any musician to submit a version for a chance at inclusion on the subsequent “Wreath of Barbs” MCD. The album has since seen multiple reissues, including a 2017 “Concentrated Camp Edition” and a DAT edition, and Wumpscut announced vinyl reissues of “Wreath of Barbs” and “Body Census” in December 2021. About Wumpscut Wumpscut, stylised as :wumpscut:, is a gothic-influenced electro-industrial project founded in Munich, Bavaria, in May 1991 by DJ Rudy Ratzinger, born Rudolf Ratzinger in 1966 in Gangkofen, West Germany. Ratzinger has remained the project’s sole member throughout its history, occasionally bringing in guest contributors such as vocalist Aleta Welling. He has cited the early work of Leæther Strip as his reason for moving from DJing to recording, saying in a 1997 interview that he “was a DJ for several years and was tired of offering the audience only alien stuff.” Wumpscut’s first release was the demo cassette “Defcon” in late 1991, followed by the project’s first full-length album, “Music for a Slaughtering Tribe,” in 1993. That album’s track “Soylent Green” drew early attention in goth and industrial club circuits in Germany, the UK and the US. Wumpscut released “Bunkertor 7” in 1995 and “Embryodead” in 1997, the latter reaching #20 on the CMJ RPM chart. The 1999 album “Boeses Junges Fleisch,” built around the life of German serial killer Fritz Haarmann, reached #25 on the CMJ RPM chart and #17 on the German Alternative Charts. The 2000 EP “Blutkind” followed, reaching #5 on the DAC Top 50 Albums of 2000 in Germany and #17 on the CMJ RPM chart in the US. Ratzinger started his own label, Beton Kopf Media, in 1995 to release Wumpscut material to the European market, and later ran the label Mental Ulcer Forges. “Wreath of Barbs,” released in 2001 through Beton Kopf Media in Germany and Metropolis Records in the US, reached #13 on the CMJ RPM Chart, the project’s highest US chart placement to date. Wumpscut has continued releasing albums since, including “Wüterich” (2016), “Fledermavs 303” (2021), “Schlossgheist” (2024) and “Chew Chew Chew” (2025), while remaining a studio-only project that has never toured. Twenty-five years on, “Wreath of Barbs” remains one of the project’s most commercially successful releases.
items._cn_summary: Wumpscut第八张录音室专辑《Wreath of Barbs》于2001年10月发行，正值发行25周年纪念。德国巴伐利亚音乐人Rudy Ratzinger独自完成全部创作、编曲、演奏、混音和母带制作，Aleta Welling为两首曲目贡献女声和歌词。专辑收录十一首作品，包含原创曲目及对Kirlian Camera作品的混音，主题围绕黑暗、仇恨、暴力等意象展开。发行同期Ratzinger通过官网举办标题曲混音比赛，邀请音乐人参与后续MCD作品。该作在美国CMJ RPM榜单达到第13位，曾获Exclaim!杂志评论肯定。厂牌Beton Kopf Media和Metropolis Records均为独立地下发行。文中内容偏向纪念性新闻梳理与专辑基本信息介绍，缺乏对音乐技法、声响设计或艺术手法的深入评论与分析。

items._cn_summary: 这是三人乐队SATELLITE LOVERS 1994年首张专辑的再版，由橋本徹参与共同制作。乐评将其归入〈渋谷系〉范畴，描述其特征为以灵魂乐为根基的常青式歌曲写作，搭配带有独立气质、色彩清新的器乐编配，将九十年代前半叶日本独立音乐场景的氛围原样封存。乐队早年默默无闻，后因海外重新发掘而获得关注，因此促成了这张旧作的复刻发行。整体来看，这是一张带有时代感与都市质地的复古作品，以旋律与编曲为核心，并未涉及实验性声音设计或跨界融合，与先锋、前卫、暗潮或电子等方向关联甚微。

items.body: Disorder Festival, a new two-day event dedicated to the international goth, coldwave, darkwave, post-punk and EBM scenes, takes place in Montreuil, just outside Paris, on 6 and 7 February 2027. The festival spreads across four venues in the same neighbourhood instead of a single site: La Marbrerie, Le Chinois, Le Bal Chavaux and La Bicyclette. The first fifteen acts have already been announced, among them Martin Dupont, Frustration and David Shaw & The Beat, with more names still to come. A further wave of artists is due to be revealed on 30 October. Some artists will be available for interviews, and press and photo accreditation can be arranged through the festival’s local PR, Take Me Out. About Disorder Festival Disorder is a new festival built around the international goth, coldwave, darkwave, post-punk and EBM scenes, set to debut in Montreuil on 6 and 7 February 2027. The organisers are spreading the event across four venues in the same part of Montreuil instead of concentrating it in one site: La Marbrerie, Le Chinois, Le Bal Chavaux and La Bicyclette. The first confirmed names include Martin Dupont, Frustration and David Shaw & The Beat, with the remainder of the fifteen-act first wave and a further round of bookings still to be made public.
items._cn_summary: 本文并非乐评，而是一则关于2027年2月在巴黎近郊蒙特勒伊举办的全新两日音乐节Disorder Festival的官方新闻稿。内容介绍了音乐节选址于La Marbrerie、Le Chinois、Le Bal Chavaux和La Bicyclette四个场地，涵盖国际哥特、冷浪潮、暗浪潮、后朋克与电子舞曲场景，已公布首批十五组艺人包括Martin Dupont、Frustration和David Shaw & The Beat等，第二波阵容将于10月30日揭晓。文章通篇为活动公告性质，无任何关于音乐风格分析、声音设计、演出评价或艺术价值的讨论，因此无法作为音乐内容来评价。对于关注暗潮与后朋克场景的乐迷而言，这是获取演出信息的实用渠道，但缺乏任何乐评层面的深度。

items.body: Antonio Vivaldi, the red-haired priest and virtuoso violinist, spent much of his career as music master at the Ospedale della Pietà, a Venetian orphanage famous for its music. He composed The Four Seasons around 1720, while serving as court chapel master in Mantua. In 1725 they were published in Amsterdam as the opening concertos of his Op. 8, a set of twelve titled Il cimento dell’armonia e dell’inventione. After Vivaldi’s death in 1741 his music was largely forgotten for nearly two centuries, and the Seasons returned with the revival of his work in the twentieth century. Each concerto follows the same plan of three movements, fast, slow and fast, for solo violin, strings and continuo. Each was also printed with a sonnet, and Vivaldi set its images in the music: birdsong, a summer storm, peasants dancing at the harvest, teeth chattering in the winter cold. Few works have been recorded more often, and the versions range from full modern string orchestras to small groups with one player on each part, on modern or period instruments. Nigel Kennedy’s 1989 album alone sold millions of copies and brought the music to a huge new audience. Here are The Classic Review editorial team’s recommendations for the 10 best recordings of Vivaldi’s The Four Seasons. Giuliano Carmignola, Venice Baroque Orchestra, Andrea Marcon Giuliano Carmignola’s 1999 recording with Andrea Marcon and the Venice Baroque Orchestra is the natural first choice. Carmignola takes the fast movements at high speed and with great energy, yet the textures stay light and the playing crisp. The tension mounts steadily through each concerto, and Winter is especially gripping. At times the pace is pushed almost too far, but the excitement more than makes up for it. The disc also includes three other Vivaldi violin concertos, recorded here for the first time. Carmignola Amazon Presto Apple Fabio Biondi, Europa Galante Fabio Biondi and Europa Galante first recorded the Seasons in 1991, in a celebrated version. Nine years later they returned to the work, once more playing from Vivaldi’s manuscripts rather than the printed edition. Compared with Carmignola, the performance is freer and less predictable. Biondi’s bowing is full of surprises, the bass lines are attacked almost like percussion, and the storm that ends Summer is fierce and very fast. The slow movements, in contrast, are tender and deeply felt. Not everyone will enjoy its liberties, but it is one of the most imaginative recordings of the work. Biondi Amazon Presto Apple Rachel Podger, Brecon Baroque Rachel Podger’s 2017 recording with Brecon Baroque uses just one player on each part, which turns the Seasons into chamber music. Even so, the sound is full rather than thin, helped by an excellent recording. Podger plays with easy brilliance and obvious pleasure, and the rest of the group is just as lively. The birdsong in the first movement of Spring is especially vivid. For all its small scale, this is not a radical reading: it stays closer to tradition than some other recent versions. Podger Amazon Presto Apple Nigel Kennedy, English Chamber Orchestra This 1989 album owed much of its huge success to Nigel Kennedy’s personality. He directs the English Chamber Orchestra himself, and the recording places his violin firmly in the foreground. Kennedy adds his own ornaments and treats the tempo freely, yet the playing remains disciplined. The heavy vibrato is a matter of taste, and from Autumn onward a few added effects sound odd. Even so, the performance is as lively as ever. Kennedy Amazon Presto Apple Adrian Chandler, La Serenissima This 2015 recording with La Serenissima is the first of Adrian Chandler’s two versions of the work. Like Biondi, he worked from Vivaldi’s manuscript parts and prepared his own edition, but the result is very different. Chandler lets the sonnets guide the performance, and his phrasing often recalls folk song. The rhythms are taut, the textures transparent, and he adds very few ornaments of his own. The biggest surprise comes at the very start of Autumn, where a Baroque guitar joins the accompaniment and the familiar opening tune is phrased in an unexpected way. The disc also includes two bassoon concertos with Peter Whelan. For anyone who thinks they know the Seasons too well, this is the recording to hear. Chandler Amazon Presto Apple Simon Standage, The English Concert, Trevor Pinnock Trevor Pinnock’s 1981 recording with the English Concert was one of the early period-instrument versions, and it has aged well. Pinnock directs from the harpsichord, and Simon Standage plays the solo part with confidence and bite. The ensemble sound is warm and full, but never heavy. The performance avoids sudden shocks and extremes, so it can seem a little plain compared with the bolder recordings that came later. In return, it offers a balanced and deeply satisfying account of all four concertos. Pinnock Amazon Presto Apple Nils-Erik Sparf, Drottningholm Baroque Ensemble The Drottningholm Baroque Ensemble’s 1984 recording, led from the violin by Nils-Erik Sparf, is understated by design, and that is its charm. Sparf shapes the phrases with subtle changes of speed and volume, and he never hurries. In the accompaniment, a pipe organ is often heard prominently instead of the more common harpsichord, which gives the performance a softer edge. The tuning is excellent, the tone rounder than usual for period instruments, and the players sound as if they enjoy every moment. Those who want high drama should look elsewhere, but this is a recording to come back to. Sparf Amazon Presto Apple Felix Ayo, I Musici I Musici’s 1959 recording with Felix Ayo was a best seller long before period instruments changed how this music is performed, and its elegance has not dated. The players work without a conductor and move as one, and Ayo’s solos are full of feeling, his virtuosity never put on show for its own sake. The scenes in the sonnets are painted with care: in the slow movement of Spring, the barking of the goatherd’s dog, played by the viola, comes through clearly. The vibrato is moderate and the tempos are generally relaxed. It remains one of the most rewarding of the traditional versions. Ayo Amazon Presto Apple Itzhak Perlman, London Philharmonic Orchestra Where Ayo is restrained, Itzhak Perlman’s 1976 recording with the London Philharmonic is unashamedly lavish: a full string orchestra, a sweet tone and a soloist in the grand manner. The slow movements are the heart of the recording, with Perlman shaping each melody in long, unbroken lines. Next to the smaller groups, it can feel heavy, and the fast movements have less bite. For listeners who care more about beauty of sound than period style, it remains a strong old-school choice. Perlman Amazon Presto Apple Janine Jansen As in Podger’s version, Janine Jansen’s 2004 recording uses just one player on each part, but here the instruments are modern. Her small group, which includes her brother on cello and her father at the keyboard, plays with clean textures and plenty of vigor. Jansen is at her finest in the quiet music, where her playing has a rare delicacy. Some accents are overstated, and the tempos are on the safe side. The disc is also short, with nothing but the four concertos in under forty minutes, but it is a performance with a character of its own. items.body:
The 17th Golden Indie Music Awards (GIMA) has unveiled its nominees, with Sunset Rollercoaster, ena mori, KIKI, and N.Y.P.D. 南洋派對 among the acts in the running.

The Taiwanese awards, which celebrate original music, received a record 4,242 submissions this year. Its Best Asian Creative Artist category, dedicated to artists from across Asia outside Taiwan, also reached a new high with 105 entries.

Sunset Rollercoaster’s QUIT QUIETLY is nominated for Best Album, Best Band, and Best Alternative Pop Album, while 'Bluebird' is up for Best Alternative Pop Song. The band’s Tseng Kuo Hung also earned a Best Singer-songwriter nomination for QUIT QUIETLY.

Across the categories, the nominees span jazz, electronic music, hip-hop, and works rooted in different languages and local cultural traditions.

Five works are nominated for Best Asian Creative Artist:

ena mori’s Ore

KIKI’s Death of a Daisy & Birth of an Oyster

SHNTI’s Melting PT.

N.Y.P.D. 南洋派對’s DON’T LIKE 我鍾意

NAMDO CALLING (Jung Eunhye, CADEJO, and Yechan Kim)’s NAMDO CALLING

This year’s theme, "觸 TRUE", pairs the Taiwanese expression “觸” (chù), which describes the feeling of being emotionally struck by something or finding that it deeply resonates, with the English word “TRUE”. It centres on authentic creative expression and its ability to connect across cultures.

The jury is chaired by Fang Q, bassist of Taiwanese band Cosmos People, who said the record number of submissions reflects the vitality and creative diversity of Taiwan’s music scene.

Beyond the competitive categories, Yuhan Su receives the Jury Award for Over The Moons. The GIMA Impact Award honours Blue Note Taipei and its founder Tsai Bop for their longstanding contributions to Taiwan’s jazz culture and live music scene.

View this post on Instagram

A post shared by 金音GIMA (@gima_arf)

Ahead of the ceremony, GIMA LIVE will take place on 21 and 22 October at CORNER MAX in Taipei. The showcase will feature final performances by the Best Live Performance nominees to determine and reveal the winner.

The awards ceremony will be held on 31 October, at 7 PM, at Taipei Music Center, with a livestream available to international audiences.

The full nominees list, GIMA LIVE lineup, and further ceremony details will be available through GIMA’s official Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube channels.

items.body: The Fat White / Decius frontman has announced his second book, Tears Of The Patriarch; we're delighted to present an extract from it. Portrait: Brian David Stevens. Other photographs: Yaz Saoudi Tears Of The Patriarch is Lias Saoudi's second book, due to be published by White Rabbit early next year. In 2014 Lias and his brother Yaz travelled to North Africa to recreate the 'Bittersweet Symphony' for an experimental Fat White Family single about circumcision. Which was all fun and games until the pair ended up in Algerian jail... All these bands speaking in regional accents instead of singing, it vexed me. Vexed me because I have no region. Vexed me because it seemed like a cult of authenticity, a provincial fetish... The post Today You Become Man, New Writing by Lias Saoudi appeared first on The Quietus.
items._cn_summary: 本文并非音乐乐评，而是一篇关于Fat White Family主唱Lias Saoudi第二本书《Tears Of The Patriarch》的出版预告与节选片段。文章提到2014年他与兄弟Yaz前往北非重拍《Bittersweet Symphony》MV用于一首关于割礼的实验单曲，并因此在阿尔及利亚被捕。节选文字带有自传式与文化反思性质，批评那些用地方口音说话而非歌唱的乐队，将其视为一种对真实性的崇拜与地方崇拜。文章涉及北非地域背景与文化批评视角，但内容更偏向文学创作与新闻发布，缺乏对音乐本身的音响、编曲或美学方面的实质评论，信息量不足以构成完整的乐评。

items.body: Review by brainsuccasurgery — Formed in 1997 from the ashes of Violet District?making it one of the oldest active neo-prog bands today? RPWL started out as a simple Pink Floyd tribute band but quickly managed to branch out?without betraying that influence?finding, as early as the album *God Has Failed* (2000), a sound and style all its own that has endured to this day, with just a few stylistic variations. Musically, *Crime Scene* doesn't shake things up. To our great delight, we find Yogi Lang's hazy melodies sung languidly in his velvety voice, and Kalle Wallner's majestic guitar, as determined as ever to deliver his beautiful Floydian solos that soar and glide along a thread suspended in the sky. All of this has always played a major role in the addictive charm of this timeless music. The absence of keyboardist Markus Jehle is the only notable change in this regard, leaving the spotlight entirely to Yogi Lang and his synthesizers?which are a bit more subdued than usual, though he doesn't forget to treat us, toward the end of the album, to his unchanging and unmissable Mini-Moog solo in the purest spirit of Manfred Mann's MMEB era. Certain tracks on *Crime Scene*, however, offer some welcome surprises, such as the lively intro to the brilliant and powerful "Victim of Desire," which is closer in style to Yes than to Pink Floyd. And the touch of '60s psychedelia on "A Cold Spring Day in '22." The heavy, offbeat riff?bordering on stoner rock?in "Another Life Beyond Control" also stands out in an album that some might find a little too polished. "King of the World" (12:51) is the album's pi�ce de r�sistance, unusually long for the band, which allows it?without any lulls, on a rhythm section once again closer to Yes than to Pink Floyd?to traverse a whole range of musical emotions worthy of the golden age of '70s prog, against a backdrop of Mellotron evoking the gloomy moods of our youth, when we walked with our heads down and raised them only to implore the heavens to restore our childlike carefreeness. Where the Bavarians are most surprising is in the theme?anything but trivial?chosen for their eighth studio album. The memorable *Tales from Outer Space* (2019) imagined that salvation for our species would come from space. After the interstellar journey comes a plunge into the deep night of the human soul to shed light on its most violent aspects. As its title makes quite clear, *Crime Scene* doesn't offer a selection of fairy tales for young children but instead sets out to recount a series of edifying stories. Starting with the dark "Victim of Desire," a veritable encounter with a nightmare, A disturbing news item that might provoke a sense of unease in the most sensitive among us, as if certain symptoms of some kind of post-traumatic neurosis?one we might be suffering from without even knowing it?were resurfacing. Through a story as sad as the sun's permanent absence, the bluesy "Red Rose" attempts to show us just how far mad love can lead. The catchy and effective "A Cold Spring Day in '22" in turn tells us another deeply grim story of a decimated family. It's a masterclass in the art of contrast between music and lyrics. Violence in our society?violence committed by human beings against one another, self-destructive and unnatural?has it not been present since the dawn of time, ever since this species came to be called "human"? Violence is everywhere?all around us and within each of us. But above all, *Crime Scene*, as a mirror reflecting the sickening prevalence of all violence against women perpetrated by men, presents us with an image that leaves no one indifferent. We may feel very distant from the dramatic situations depicted here?more or less graphically?and yet at the same time feel entirely affected. Are we all potential victims? And are we all potential monsters? Through six disturbing stories, curiously set to pleasant, harmonious melodies?music that is relatively peaceful by comparison?RPWL attempts, with *Crime Scene*, to offer an objective perspective that sends a chill down your spine.
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑是成立于1997年的德国新前卫摇滚乐队RPWL的第八张录音室作品。音乐延续了乐队自2000年专辑《God Has Failed》以来形成的稳定风格：以Yogi Lang慵懒朦胧的人声和Kalle Wallner飘逸的弗洛伊德式吉他为支柱，合成器替代了缺席的键盘手Markus Jehle，末段保留了标志性的Mini-Moog独奏。部分曲目加入新元素，如接近Yes风格的节奏段落、'60s迷幻色彩和stoner rock式的不寻常riff。12分半的《King of the World》在Mellotron背景下展开多段落情绪铺陈。主题上从前作的外太空叙事转向人类灵魂深处的暴力暗面，探讨欲望受害、疯狂之爱等沉重议题，歌词取材自令人不安的社会新闻。整体制作精良但风格保守，对熟悉neo-prog的听众而言是稳定的延续，未在实验性或跨界融合方向做出突破。

items.body: Review by kenethlevine — An unfortunate fate of some artists of the 1970s lies in the rapid evolution of "popular" music of that time. A band conceived in the early 1970s, formed in the mid 1970s, and finally committing their sound to new generations, even if mostly within their own family tree, in the late 1970s would be behind the times from the outset. In the case of Finnish chameleons KAAMOS, it might not have mattered since their sole release wouldn't have been original 5 years earlier, but in 1978 it was so distinctly undistinguished as to almost be innovative, but no. A pastiche of palettes from the late 1960s and early 1970s, mostly in a heavy rock vein with brushes of folk and blues, it recalls pretty much every band that was at least critically fashionable at that time, including WIGWAM which didn't sound particularly Finnish either. The playing is very competent, especially the lead guitars, organs and rhythm section, but, while they were clearly familiar with each other, I can't help feeling it's all a bit too democratic. Best deeds here would be the wildly but admirably mercurial "Strife" and the engaging instrumental "Barokki", but they can only save this one from complete ignominy.
items._genre: prog folk / heavy rock / blues rock
items._cn_summary: 芬兰乐队KAAMOS于1977年发行的这张唯一专辑，是一支生不逢时的乐队在七十年代末对六十年代末至七十年代初摇滚语汇的迟来回应。整体风格偏向重摇滚底色，间或融入民谣与布鲁斯元素，编曲涉猎管风琴与主音吉他，但听感上更像是WIGWAM等同时代乐队的拼贴式模仿。乐手演奏技术扎实，尤其是主音吉他、管风琴与节奏组的配合显得默契而克制。专辑未能形成鲜明的个人辨识度，乐评甚至直言其风格在当时已显得平庸。最值得关注的亮点是情绪波动剧烈的《Strife》与器乐曲《Barokki》，但仅凭这两首仍难以挽救整张专辑在原创性上的乏力。对于追求前卫、实验或融合听觉的听众而言，这张保守且缺乏突破的七十年代摇滚遗作与其口味相距甚远。

items.body: Review by fuxi — The best album in the style of Yes since 2001, or even since 1977? Hmmm, it's a tricky question. I've always enjoyed DRAMA (1980) and I'm not sure if it surpasses THAT. I'm not fond of THE LADDER or MAGNIFICATION, but I only recently discovered FLY FROM HERE - RETURN TRIP and found it truly refreshing. I even thought MIRROR TO THE SKY (2023) had its moments, especially when Steve Howe takes flight, but I can't stand Jon Davison's emasculated vocals or the nonsense he's singing. And here we touch upon something essential, for is Jon Anderson's nonsense any better? I must admit I'd find TRUE ten times more enjoyable if we got to hear something more enlightening than 'Cup a sound now, chook around, chook around / Everything now, moving out, moving out / Once upon a time you were searching for / Dance around it, tiki-tai, tiki-tay'. But then, even at age eighty Anderson's voice undeniably has power, and that's something they can't take away. The melodies he (co-) wrote are pleasant, and the Band Geeks are blessed with keyboard players and a Yes-style rhythm section that's far superior to anything Yes's current incarnation have to offer. Besides, Steve Graziano on lead guitar isn't half bad either. I recently saw Jon Anderson & The Band Geeks live (admittedly with a different lead guitarist in tow) and their vitality greatly impressed me. Ever since that gig I try to let TRUE's buoyant spirit carry me away. It doesn't seem likely that Steve Howe and Jon Anderson will ever make up, which is tragic, because didn't they write most of CLOSE TO THE EDGE and TOPOGRAPHIC OCEANS together? But as things stand, dedicated Yes fans will probably get a lot of pleasure out of TRUE.
items._cn_summary: 这是Yes前主唱Jon Anderson在八十岁高龄发布的专辑，与The Band Geeks乐队合作录制。乐评将其与Yes'2023年专辑《Mirror to the Sky》对比，认为Anderson的声音依然有力，但其作词仍延续以往晦涩难解的风格。键盘手与节奏组的演奏水平被评价为超越Yes现任阵容，吉他手Steve Graziano的表现也获肯定。专辑整体呈现七十年代Yes式的前卫摇滚美学，旋律轻快且富有活力。从用户口味角度看，这是一张较为传统的复古风格前卫摇滚作品，缺乏实验性元素、跨领域融合或声音设计上的突破，与实验、前卫爵士、电子或世界音乐等偏好领域距离较远。

items.body: Ministry‘s “Moral Hygiene” turns 5 on 1 October. The industrial metal band released its fifteenth studio album through Nuclear Blast on 1 October 2021, produced by Al Jourgensen. The record runs ten tracks and 47 minutes, and it marked the first Ministry album since 2012’s “Relapse” to include a cover song. “Moral Hygiene” was recorded over roughly three years following 2018’s “AmeriKKKant” and is the first Ministry album to feature bassist Paul D’Amour, formerly of Tool, who joined the band in 2019. It is also the first record since 2006’s “Rio Grande Blood” without guitarist Sin Quirin, who left Ministry in March 2021. The album’s cover of Iggy Pop and James Williamson’s “Search and Destroy” was released as a single on 20 August 2021, alongside “Alert Level” (24 April 2020) and “Good Trouble” (8 July 2021), the latter accompanied by a “Unity Mix” the band put out to honor civil rights leader John Lewis. Guest musicians on “Moral Hygiene” include guitarist Billy Morrison, former Megadeth bassist David Ellefson, former N.W.A member Arabian Prince, and Jello Biafra, Jourgensen’s former bandmate in Lard, who takes lead vocals on “Sabotage Is Sex.” The album was engineered by Michael Rozon and mastered by Dave Donnelly. It was released on CD, vinyl, cassette and digital formats via Nuclear Blast. Moral Hygiene by Ministry About Ministry Ministry formed in Chicago in 1981 as the synthpop project of Al Jourgensen. The band’s 1983 debut, “With Sympathy,” was released through Arista Records and leaned toward the synth-driven sound of the era, a direction Jourgensen later disowned as label-imposed. Ministry’s sound shifted toward the aggressive, guitar-driven industrial style that would define the band starting with 1986’s “Twitch,” produced with Adrian Sherwood, and continuing through 1988’s “The Land of Rape and Honey” and 1989’s “The Mind Is a Terrible Thing to Taste,” both released on Sire Records. The band’s commercial breakthrough came with 1992’s “Psalm 69: The Way to Succeed and the Way to Suck Eggs,” which went platinum in the United States and included the single “Jesus Built My Hotrod” featuring Gibby Haynes of the Butthole Surfers. Ministry continued through the 1990s with “Filth Pig” (1996) and “Dark Side of the Spoon” (1999), then released “Animositisomina” (2003), the final album to feature longtime bassist Paul Barker, before Jourgensen turned to a trilogy of albums aimed at the George W. Bush administration: “Houses of the Molé” (2004), “Rio Grande Blood” (2006) and “The Last Sucker” (2007). Jourgensen announced Ministry’s retirement after “The Last Sucker,” then reactivated the band with 2012’s “Relapse,” recorded after he survived a near-fatal ruptured ulcer. Ministry has released albums steadily since, including “From Beer to Eternity” (2013), featuring posthumous contributions from guitarist Mike Scaccia, “AmeriKKKant” (2018), “Moral Hygiene” (2021) and “Hopiumforthemasses” (2024), each addressing the political landscape of its release year. Jourgensen remains the band’s sole constant member, working alongside a rotating cast of musicians including longtime guitarist Cesar Soto and, since 2019, bassist Paul D’Amour. “Moral Hygiene” extended that run five years ago this October, arriving as Ministry’s fifteenth studio album.
items._cn_summary: 本文并非真正意义上的乐评，而是一篇关于Ministry专辑《Moral Hygiene》发行五周年的纪念性新闻稿，内容以信息陈述为主，缺乏对音乐本身的深度分析或审美评价。文章交代了专辑的制作背景、录制周期、阵容变化（包括前Tool贝斯手Paul D'Amour加入、吉他手Sin Quirin离队）、客座乐人（如Billy Morrison、David Ellefson、Arabian Prince、Jello Biafra）以及单曲发行时间线等信息，并附带了乐队从1981年成立至今的简史。作为一支以激进吉他驱动的工业金属乐队，Ministry的作品虽然在工业/暗潮领域有历史地位，但该专辑的制作风格更接近主流工业金属，未见突出的实验性或跨领域融合元素。文章未对音色设计、编曲结构或主题表达进行任何实质性讨论，无法为读者提供聆听参考价值。

items.body: Lacrimosa released their seventh studio album, “Fassade,” through Hall of Sermon and Nuclear Blast on 1 October 2001. The gothic metal record turns 25 this year. The Swiss duo, Tilo Wolff and Anne Nurmi, recorded and mixed “Fassade” between January and June 2001 at Impuls Musicproductions in Hamburg, with orchestral parts performed by the Deutsches Filmorchester Babelsberg recorded in March 2001 at the Scoring Stage in Berlin. JP Genkel recorded and mixed the album, and Helge Halvé handled mastering in July 2001. Wolff arranged, produced and sang on the record; Nurmi wrote and sang the album’s English-language track, “Senses,” while Wolff wrote the remaining seven songs. The eight-track album is built around the title piece “Fassade,” a three-part composition split across tracks one, five and eight, with the remaining songs, “Der Morgen danach,” “Senses,” “Warum so tief?,” “Liebesspiel” and “Stumme Worte,” filling out a 52-minute run time. “Fassade” reached number 20 on the German Albums Chart and number 31 in Switzerland, following 1999’s “Elodia,” which had marked the band’s commercial breakthrough with the London Symphony Orchestra. “Fassade” streams on Spotify. About Lacrimosa Tilo Wolff founded Lacrimosa in Frankfurt, Germany, in 1990, recording a demo tape titled “Clamor” before launching his own label, Hall of Sermon, in 1991 to release the debut album “Angst.” A harlequin has appeared on every Lacrimosa album cover since, becoming the band’s logo. Wolff released “Einsamkeit” (1992) and “Satura” (1993) as the project’s sole member before Finnish musician Anne Nurmi, formerly of the gothic rock band Two Witches, joined as a permanent second member in 1994. Nurmi has contributed her own compositions in Finnish and English on every album since “Inferno” (1995), which became the band’s first charting release in Germany. “Stille” (1997) introduced the heavier, symphonic metal direction that defined the band’s sound going forward. “Elodia” (1999) became Lacrimosa’s commercial breakthrough, reaching number 12 in Germany with orchestral parts recorded by the London Symphony Orchestra at Abbey Road Studios. “Fassade” followed on 1 October 2001, continuing the orchestral approach with the Deutsches Filmorchester Babelsberg, an arrangement repeated on “Echos” (2003). In 2008, Hall of Sermon reclaimed the rights to the band’s back catalogue from Nuclear Blast, restoring full independence over the discography. Lacrimosa continued to release albums through the 2000s and 2010s, including “Lichtgestalt” (2005), “Sehnsucht” (2009), “Revolution” (2012), “Hoffnung” (2015) and “Testimonium” (2017), the latter a requiem in four acts dedicated to musicians who died in 2016. Side-Line marked the band’s 25th anniversary in 2015 with the announcement of a new studio album, and reported on the band’s 2021 return with “Leidenschaft,” delayed at the time by a worldwide paper shortage. Side-Line also covered the 2023 release of the double live CD “Nachts” on Hall of Sermon. “Lament,” released in 2025, completed a stylistic trilogy begun with “Testimonium” and debuted at number 7 in Germany, the band’s highest chart position since “Elodia.” Lacrimosa remains one of the longest-running self-released acts in the gothic metal scene, operating continuously through Wolff’s own label since 1991. “Fassade” turns 25 this year, marking a quarter century since the band’s most explicit engagement with themes of individuality and societal conformity.

items._cn_summary: 日本爵士钢琴家海野雅威将于东京有乐町举办向奥斯卡·彼得森经典专辑《We Get Requests》致敬的演出。以钢琴三重奏形式（钢琴、贝斯、鼓），重新演绎1964年原专辑中的曲目。海野九岁时现场聆听彼得森的演出，由此立志成为爵士钢琴家，此次公演带有浓厚的个人情怀与传承意味。演出将以其个人化诠释重新呈现这张经典爵士专辑的魅力。从风格上看，这是标准的传统主流爵士三重奏致敬演出，属于商业化音乐会活动，面向一般爵士听众，与实验、前卫或电子融合方向相距较远。内容为演出新闻稿性质，侧重活动信息而非音乐艺术分析。

items.body:
Tiny Sun creates tiny songs that give off light and heat well out of proportion to their size. Composed, performed, and produced by Martina Sorbara, Jonathan Goldsmith, and Don Rooke, the record is vaguely Americana, with plucked guitars and ukuleles, chiming keyboards, and the lonesome slide of the guitar.
Vanishment
contains eighteen sparkling miniatures - that take a scant 34 minutes to negotiate - notable for their economy of arrangement and the subtle directness of the lyrics. The tracks glow with Martina�s clear, high, and sometimes fragile voice.
The songs are about loss: lost love, lost confidence, but sometimes about resignation to the enigmatic quirks of the world. The tone of wry fatalism mirrors the fact that this project is the work of many years of collaboration and email exchanges while the trio pursued their musical day jobs. Jonathan Goldsmith is an award-winning composer for television and film, Don Rooke fronts the Toronto roots band The Henrys, and Martina Sorbara is known for folk, electropop, and her band Dragonette.
Kerosene Madrigal
The range of backgrounds leads to many styles, and the record betrays interesting influences. The opening track, �Kerosene Madrigal,� is a sort of miner�s blues reminiscent of Michelle Shocked. The soul-country of �Imagined Love� reminded me of fellow Torontonians Cowboy Junkies, especially the sweet organ. The stoic and twangy �Don�t Fault the Stars for Falling� could have been a Dolly Parton tune.
A Grand Expanse
�A Grand Expanse� has a more ambitious arrangement.  It sounds like the end-credits song from a long-ago film we only vaguely remember. It says everything it needs to in one minute and twenty seconds and exactly 38 words. It is quintessential Tiny Sun.
The entire recording feels like music from a dream, and since no one knows exactly what dream music sounds like, this could be it.
Berceuse
Tiny Sun will perform the entire album at Toronto�s Koerner Hall on May 14, 2026.

items._cn_summary: 这张专辑由三位音乐人远程协作完成，历时多年通过邮件交流打磨出十八首短小精致的民谣小品。编曲以原声吉他、尤克里里、滑棒吉他和键盘为主，歌曲时长极短，歌词简洁直率，主题围绕失去的爱与命运的无奈展开。Sorbara清澈高亢的嗓音是专辑的主要载体，音乐风格游走于民谣、乡村布鲁斯与独立流行之间。整体气质带有梦幻感和怀旧色彩，部分曲目如《A Grand Expanse》被比作老电影片尾曲。虽然融合了三人各自在电视配乐、根源音乐和电子流行方面的背景，但专辑本身并未展现出显著的实验性或前卫倾向，风格相对温和内敛，与实验、前卫或电子融合等取向有较大距离。
